name: llm-bot-eval-kit
description: Regression-test an LLM chatbot like code: persona scenarios, prompt-injection probes, a golden-conversation gate, a browser smoke gate and a clock-shift CI guard.

scripts.test: for f in $(find test -name '_*test.mjs' | sort); do echo "== $f =="; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:future: for f in $(find test -name '_*test.mjs' | sort); do echo "== $f (clock +183d) =="; node gates/clock-shift.mjs 183 "$f" || exit 1; done
